### Trading Playbook (November 19, 2026)

#### 🎯 Next Day Playbook (Short-Term Catalyst)
For tomorrow's session, focus on **Software, Technology, Energy**. These sectors are displaying massive short-term relative momentum (Y-Axis) on the Daily RRG, indicating aggressive immediate capital inflows.

#### 📈 Next Week Playbook (Swing Trade Leaders)
For multi-day or weekly swing trades, allocate to **Consumer Staples, Utilities, Consumer Discr**. These are the undisputed structural leaders on the Weekly RRG, firmly planted in the Leading quadrant with both high trend and high momentum.

#### ⚠️ Fading Momentum Warnings
**Watch Out:** Financials, Industrials, Consumer Discr, Real Estate have crossed down into the Weakening quadrant. Their structural trend is still high, but their immediate momentum has collapsed. This is a primary signal to take profits or tighten stop losses.
